briefdescription.para: Name of the pass that triggers this report.

detaileddescription.para: If this matches the regular expression given in -Rpass=regexp, then the remark will be emitted.

briefdescription.para: Textual identifier for the remark (single-word, camel-case).

detaileddescription.para: Can be used by external tools reading the output file for optimization remarks to identify the remark.

briefdescription.para: If profile information is available, this is the number of times the corresponding code was executed in a profile instrumentation run.
Arguments collected via the streaming interface.
The remark is expected to be noisy.
If positive, the index of the first argument that only appear in the optimization records and not in the remark printed in the compiler output.

memberdef.argsstring: (enum DiagnosticKind Kind, enum DiagnosticSeverity Severity, const char *PassName, StringRef RemarkName, const Function &Fn, const DiagnosticLocation &Loc)
memberdef.name: DiagnosticInfoOptimizationBase

briefdescription.para: PassName is the name of the pass emitting this diagnostic.

detaileddescription.para: RemarkName is a textual identifier for the remark (single-word, camel-case). Fn is the function where the diagnostic is being emitted. Loc is the location information to use in the diagnostic. If line table information is available, the diagnostic will include the source code location.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this optimization remark is enabled by one of of the LLVM command line flags (-pass-remarks, -pass-remarks-missed, or -pass-remarks-analysis).

detaileddescription.para: Note that this only handles the LLVM flags. We cannot access Clang flags from here (they are handled in BackendConsumer::OptimizationRemarkHandler).

briefdescription.para: Common features for diagnostics dealing with optimization remarks that are used by both IR and MIR passes.
